systems.system: SIFEC (Système d'intégration des faits d'état civil)
systems.owner: the Congolese authorities, as presented by Congo's delegate at the Abidjan symposium
systems.tiers: all civil-status services; in December 2024 not yet deployed, awaiting a new civil-status law, with digitisation promised by 2026

note: Abidjan civil-status symposium, 10-12 December 2024: for Congo it reports only the planned SIFEC civil-status application; the 'communes' hit is Burkina Faso's. Nothing on the connection of local government offices.
